name: Massachusetts Boys State
org: The American Legion, Massachusetts Boys State Committee
what_you_do: Spend a week at Stonehill College running a pretend state government. You take classes, run for office, join a band, court or newspaper, and play sports.
grades: Finished 11th grade, with at least one semester of high school left
who_can_apply: Boys who finished junior year and have at least one semester left. You cannot have gone to a Boys State before. Leadership, character, grades and service to your school are what count. A parent and a family doctor must sign a medical consent form.
pay_detail: No pay. The goal is that tuition is paid by your local American Legion post, the Massachusetts Boys State and Girls State Foundation, a school or town, or a sponsor.
duration: One week: the 83rd Annual Session is June 12 to June 18, 2027
deadline_text: Session dates: June 12 to June 18, 2027. The site says applications open in late 2026. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the program interest form on the site. You will be told when applications open (late 2026). The application has your information and a short response on what Boys State would mean to you. It also has a reference from a teacher or guidance counselor. You can also ask your local Legion post or guidance counselor.
notes: Boys only (Massachusetts Girls State is a separate program). You are expected to attend the whole week. It falls during many schools' finals, so ask your school about make-up plans early. The interest form link is the one on the home page.
